newsitem.title: USA: Ohio Senate panel to weigh Cleveland school plan.
newsitem.headline: Ohio Senate panel to weigh Cleveland school plan.

text.p: An Ohio senate committee scheduled a first hearing Tuesday on a proposal to give Cleveland Mayor Michael White control of the fiscally troubled city public schools.
The bill would allow the mayor to appoint school board members, a chief executive officer and chief financial officer. It also mandates a voter referendum on continuing the arrangement in four years.
Representatives approved the bill on May 13. The Senate education committee hearing will be the first action on the bill in the state Senate, a legislative aide said.

The state assumed control of the Cleveland schools in 1995. Action on the bill has been slowed while lawmakers worked on state budget issues and approval of the proposal could take several weeks, the aide said.
Senators unveiled their budget proposals on Tuesday for the fiscal biennium, which begins July 1.
